mike: Starting prod deploy for `release/v1.2.3` in the 02:00-03:00 change window. Canary=5%. Targets: runtime, api, console. Pinning runtime -> v1.2.3-rc2.

deploy-bot: [1767890123] STARTED fanout deploy -> env=prod tag=release/v1.2.3 initiator=@mike

deploy-bot: queued -> runtime(pool-a), api(pool-b), console(pool-c)

jess: @mike watching api canaries. will report after first 5 reqs.

deploy-bot: [1767890180] runtime -> CANARY PASS (5/5 OK) pod=runtime-7a

nina: tracing looks clean for runtime, latency within SLO. no 5xx in last 2m.

deploy-bot: [1767890210] api -> CANARY FAIL (2/5 errors) sample_error=502 upstream timeout

sam: 👀 seeing the same. @sre-oncall can you check LB and backend-x?

sre-oncall: looking. backend-x CPU spike + throttling rule triggered, routing fallback pool to reduce load.

deploy-bot: api -> PAUSING rollout for investigation; keeping canary traffic pinned.

sam: Recommend rollback api canary to previous stable tag `release/v1.2.2` and continue runtime/console.

sre-oncall: I'll reroute and clear throttling, created temp rule to limit concurrent connections to backend-x.

deploy-bot: [1767890275] api -> ROLLBACK initiated to tag=release/v1.2.2 reason="upstream timeouts" executor=deploy-bot

mike: Decision: proceed with runtime + console. api will be pinned to v1.2.2 until ENG-482 backend fix. Update release notes and feature flags.

deploy-bot: [1767890330] console -> SUCCESS commit=abc123 duration=40s

deploy-bot: [1767890345] runtime -> SUCCESS commit=def456 duration=120s

jess: added note to deploy thread: "api rollback due to backend timeouts, follow-up ticket ENG-482" and flagged product.

leah: Product acked. We'll hold the api feature flags and block progressive rollout until confirmed.

deploy-bot: [1767890400] FANOUT SUMMARY -> runtime=SUCCESS, console=SUCCESS, api=ROLLED_BACK final_state=partial_deploy

mike: Nice work. I'll post final release notes and include rollback rationale + rollback tag.

deploy-bot: [1767890450] NOTIFIED channels=#release-notes,#oncall; thread closed. :white_check_mark:
